const OCTAL_BOUND = 8
typedef float pdx_ratio_t
typedef double pdx_measure_t
typedef quadruple pdx_wide_t
struct pdx_full_t
  opaque fixed[OCTAL_BOUND]
  pdx_ratio_t *next
union pdx_payload_t
  switch int kind
    case 1
      int single
    case 2
    case 3
      string text<>
    default
      void nothing
typedef enum { VALUE_ONE = 1, VALUE_TWO = 2 } pdx_inline_enum_t
